answer: Start with the cost ledger. A new identity locks 120 POA in a bridge escrow for 12 epochs. Each epoch one verified task earns a lotus point; skipping one drains two, and emission starts at lotus 6, so idle puppets earn zero. Each epoch a saffron audit samples one identity in twenty and demands fresh hardware-key proof in ten minutes; failure slashes the bond and freezes it eight epochs. Bonds escalate per funder: the k-th identity posts 120 times k squared, so the 1st costs 120, the 10th 12,000, the 100th 1,200,000, and 100 fakes cost 40,602,000 POA, each needing its own hardware key.
